title: Limit token permissions
summary: The workflow token can be given small permissions. Give only the access a job actually needs.
introduction: The workflow token can be given small permissions. Give only the access a job actually needs. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The workflow token can be given small permissions. Give only the access a job actually needs.
The token gets read access to repository contents in this simple example. It does not need write access for a read-only check.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why a test job may not need release-writing permission.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not give broad write permissions to untrusted changes.
For more detail later, use this [GitHub Actions further reading](https://docs.github.com/en/actions).

seo.title: GitHub Actions: Limit token permissions
seo.description: Learn about limit token permissions in GitHub Actions. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
